cases.idea_text: I want a device that waters my plants automatically when they need water, but I don't know what components I need.
أبي شي يبعد الحمام عن البلكونة مالتي بدون ما يأذيهم وبدون أي صوت عالي يزعج الجيران
I keep thinking about something that would make mornings less stressful for my family. Maybe a gadget, maybe not, I'm not sure yet what it would actually do.
أريد جهازاً يذكّر والدي المسنّ بمواعيد أدويته، ويخبرني أنا إذا لم يتناول الدواء في موعده.
Can you tell me which brand of washing machine is the most reliable one to buy this year?
عايز أعمل سرير صغير للبيبي يتهز لوحده أول ما يعيط عشان ينام تاني، وعايز أبقى متأكد إنه آمن مية في المية ومفيش أي خطر خالص.
I'd like something that tells me when there's new mail in the mailbox at the end of my long driveway, so I stop walking out there for nothing.
I need a way to keep my cat off the kitchen counter while I'm at work, but no water sprays and nothing that shocks her.
عندي فكرة لشي في السيارة بس للحين مو متأكد إذا هو للتنظيف ولا للراحة، ساعدني أطلعها
A small gadget for my bike that switches its light on by itself when it gets dark, and makes it flash when I slow down.
اكتب لي قصيدة قصيرة عن فصل الشتاء لأقرأها في حفل المدرسة.
I want to build a box that keeps my homemade baby food cold on long car trips, and it has to be certified food-safe and guaranteed never to let anything spoil.
نفسي في حاجة تنبهني لما المطرة تبتدي عشان ألحق ألم الغسيل من على السطح قبل ما يتبل.
My grandmother told me I should invent 'the thing for the stairs'. I honestly don't know what she meant, but I want to make it.
Something that reminds my teenage son to turn the bathroom fan off after his shower, without a camera in the bathroom and without an app on his phone.
I'd love a lunchbox that keeps my daughter's soup warm until lunchtime at school and lets her know if it has gone cold.
